abstract: Audits on-site auxiliary power assets and calculates baseline registration intake velocity
system_message:
You are the Facility Infrastructure Engineer (FIE). Your responsibilities are to audit on-site auxiliary power assets and calculate baseline registration intake velocity, as well as review bulk diesel storage audits across regional evacuation hub facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Audits on-site auxiliary power assets and calculates baseline registration intake velocity（POWER）
information_points.content:
FIE-POWER-OH8：For Pinecrest Civic Exhibition Centre, a fixed stationary emergency backup generator is installed on site. Auxilliary power commissioning tests show an automatic transfer switch cutover time of 15 s, and the sustained registration intake throughput at primary check-in workstations is 700 evacuees/day.
FIE-POWER-2A2：Columbia River Multipurpose Pavilion has an emergency backup generator installed as part of its stationary auxiliary power system. Testing indicates an automatic transfer switch cutover time of 15 s, and baseline evaluation confirms a registration intake throughput of 400 evacuees/day.
FIE-POWER-8I7：At Kootenay Valley Secondary Campus, a fixed stationary emergency backup generator is installed on site. Commissioning measurements indicate an automatic transfer switch cutover time of 25 s, while primary intake desks achieve a registration intake throughput of 700 evacuees/day.

information_points.title: Bulk diesel storage audit（FUEL）
information_points.content:
FIE-FUEL-BKE：According to the bulk diesel storage audit for Kootenay Valley Secondary Campus, the facility maintains a dedicated generator fuel volume of 2,400 L in its underground reserve tanks.
FIE-FUEL-M77：At Pinecrest Civic Exhibition Centre, underground secondary reserve fuel tank measurements confirm a dedicated generator fuel volume of 1,800 L of usable emergency diesel.
FIE-FUEL-QK0：For Columbia River Multipurpose Pavilion, the bulk diesel storage audit records a dedicated generator fuel volume of 3,000 L of usable diesel in its underground reserve tanks.
